sentences.note: This stretched sound effect makes the monster feel huge and heavy.

sentences.reading: なんだ...あの ばけものは...！？
sentences.note: なんだ expresses shock: 'what is it?' or 'what the...'

sentences.japanese: あの子が...あの怪物と戦うのか...！？
sentences.reading: あのこが...あの かいぶつと たたかうのか...！？
sentences.romaji: Ano ko ga... ano kaibutsu to tatakau no ka...!?
sentences.english: That child is going to fight that monster!?
sentences.note: のか turns the statement into an emotional question.

sentences.japanese: 嘘だろ...生きて帰れるわけがない！！
sentences.reading: うそだろ...いきて かえれる わけがない！！
sentences.romaji: Uso daro... ikite kaereru wake ga nai!!
sentences.english: No way... there is no chance he can make it back alive!
sentences.note: わけがない means 'there is no reason/chance that...'

sentences.japanese: あれは伝説の深淵の魔獣...！！
sentences.reading: あれは でんせつの しんえんの まじゅう...！！
sentences.romaji: Are wa densetsu no shin'en no maju...!!
sentences.english: That is the legendary beast of the abyss!
sentences.note: 深淵 is a dramatic word for an abyss or deep chasm.

sentences.japanese: どう考えても勝てるはずがない...！！
sentences.reading: どう かんがえても かてる はずがない...！！
sentences.romaji: Do kangaete mo kateru hazu ga nai...!!
sentences.english: No matter how you look at it, he cannot possibly win!
sentences.note: どう考えても means 'however you think about it.' はずがない rejects the possibility.

sentences.japanese: なんてことをしやがるんだシャークキング...！！
sentences.reading: なんてことを しやがるんだ シャークキング...！！
sentences.romaji: Nante koto o shiyagaru n da Shaku Kingu...!!
sentences.note: しやがる is a hostile, contempt-filled way to describe someone's action.

vocabulary.note: A common word for a frightening creature.
Slightly more formal than 化け物.

vocabulary.meaning: no way; that cannot be true

vocabulary.note: Combines 生きて with 帰る.
Used for legendary beings or stories.
A dramatic fantasy word for great depth.
魔 suggests something supernatural or evil.

metadata.storyOrder: The legendary abyssal beast rises before Rio.
